pred.name: Anderson acoustic candidate site (2026)
pred.t: Proposed by Ed Anderson in March 2026, endorsed by Victor Iannello as a quick search. Based on an unexplained acoustic event at 01:15 UTC, 56 minutes after the last satellite ping, recorded at the Diego Garcia hydrophone. Stated accuracy 2–3 km. Contested: the event cannot be definitively linked to MH370, experts dispute whether it is geological, and the site is far north of where most analyses (and this model) put the aircraft. The red line shows the 7th arc for an aircraft at 20,000 ft, so the site sits about 5 km inside it. Anderson's scenario has the final signal sent from near the sea surface; the sea-level arc passes within 1 km of the site.
